query:
-- 1. users.teamId가 있는데 users.subBranchAdminId와 teams.subBranchAdminId가 다른 경우
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.role, u.teamId, u.subBranchAdminId as user_subBranchAdminId,
       t.subBranchAdminId as team_subBranchAdminId, t.name as team_name
FROM users u
JOIN teams t ON u.teamId = t.id
WHERE u.subBranchAdminId != t.subBranchAdminId
   OR (u.subBranchAdminId IS NULL AND t.subBranchAdminId IS NOT NULL)
   OR (u.subBranchAdminId IS NOT NULL AND t.subBranchAdminId IS NULL);

-- 2. team_leader/member인데 subBranchAdminId가 null인 경우
SELECT id, name, role, teamId, subBranchAdminId, accountStatus FROM users
WHERE role IN ('team_leader', 'member') AND subBranchAdminId IS NULL;

-- 3. member인데 teamId가 null인 경우
SELECT id, name, role, teamId, subBranchAdminId, accountStatus FROM users
WHERE role = 'member' AND teamId IS NULL;

-- 4. 전체 사용자 현황
SELECT id, name, role, accountStatus, teamId, subBranchAdminId FROM users ORDER BY role, id;
